title: Embeddings in 60 seconds

scenes.say: An embedding model turns text into a long list of numbers. Hundreds of them, sometimes thousands.

scenes.heading: Close in meaning, close in space
scenes.say: The trick is where those numbers land. Texts that mean similar things end up close together. I love dogs sits right next to puppies are great, and nowhere near tax law.
That one idea powers a lot.

items.title: RAG
items.say: And RAG, fetching the right passages for a model to read.

scenes.say: That's embeddings. Similar meaning, nearby numbers.

caption: Embeddings in 60 seconds: how text becomes numbers, and why similar meanings land close together.
